BH_Q.rationale: Benjamini-Hochberg across the inferential primaries (exploratory pilot).

DISTANCE_ROUND_DECIMALS.rationale: Distances are rounded to 12 decimals before ordering so floating-point noise cannot reorder ties; ties then break by (kickoff, match_id).

IQR_TO_SD.rationale: Fallback when MAD is 0: IQR/1.349 estimates the SD under normality.

MAD_TO_SD.rationale: Consistency constant making MAD estimate the SD under normality.

MIN_LONG_RUN_MATCHES.rationale: DP5 long-run reference needs >= 20 away matches before the recent block (four disjoint blocks).

MIN_METRIC_COVERAGE.rationale: A required metric must be non-null in >= 80% of the candidate subject matches, else the metric is unsupported (fail closed).

MIN_OBS_PER_PARAMETER.rationale: Regression support rule: >= 10 observations per estimated parameter (standard events-per-variable guidance).

MIN_PROFILE_DIMENSION_COVERAGE.rationale: All profile dimensions required; a distance over a subset of dimensions is a different profile.

MIN_PROFILE_MATCHES_PER_DIM.rationale: At least half the profile window must be non-null for a dimension; a mean of fewer than 5 matches is dominated by one or two games.

MIN_REFERENCE_OBS.rationale: Robust median/MAD of a competition distribution needs about 100 matches (200 team-match values) before it is stable.

MIN_SIMILAR_MATCHES.rationale: Neighbour and comparison groups each need >= 10 matches so that no one or two matches dominate a group mean.

MIN_STRENGTH_MATCHES.rationale: Strength needs >= 5 of those matches, else it is missing (never a gate on eligibility).

MIN_SUBJECT_MATCHES.rationale: Tercile split of 30 gives >= 10 neighbours and >= 20 others; also the minimum for a rank correlation with SE near 0.19.

NEIGHBOR_FRACTION.rationale: Nearest tercile of eligible subject matches; the same domain-neutral tercile grid used elsewhere in the engine, not tuned.

N_RESAMPLES.rationale: Permutation resamples for every primary null.

PROFILE_WINDOW_MATCHES.rationale: Last 10 venue-matched prior matches: the packet's own RECENT_10 horizon, and a length that does not depend on how far back the corpus happens to start (ALL_PRIOR does).

RECENT_BLOCK_MATCHES.rationale: DP5 recent block = last 5 away matches (the packet's RECENT_5 horizon applied away-only).

SHRINKAGE_KAPPA.rationale: Credibility weight n/(n+kappa) with kappa = the recent window length: a full recent window gets equal weight with its reference, the minimal-assumption choice.

STRENGTH_WINDOW_MATCHES.rationale: Opponent strength = mean goal difference over its last 10 same-competition matches.
